data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred in prior underwriting years (21,891)

prior_year_events.event_name: Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2008-2015 years of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2015 underwriting year was closed at year end by means of a reinsurance to close (RITC) transaction and all liabilities transferred to a third party syndicate. The RITC yielded a profit for the Syndicate of GBP 49m as the premium was below the booked reserves. The 2015 and 2016 years of account have seen positive claims experience and the RITC of 2015 has also resulted in a release of reserves.

The calculation of estimated profit commission payable was revised to align with the recognition of premium. This resulted in a release of profit commission payable on the 2014 and prior years of account of GBP 4.6m.

The calculation of estimated unallocated loss adjustment expenses (ULAE) was revised during calendar year 2017... This revision resulted in an overall release of GBP 7.8m of ULAE... for 2015 and prior (10,727k) and 2016 (-913k).

named_events.loss_description: Reserves have been established in respect of Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria (Gross: GBP 74,828k, Net: GBP 23,040k)
Reserves have been established in respect of Californian wildfires (Gross: GBP 7,970k, Net: GBP 7,362k)

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 21.891 million, primarily driven by positive claims experience on the 2015 and 2016 years of account. This was further supported by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transaction for the 2008 to 2015 years of account, which yielded a net profit of GBP 49 million for the 2015 underwriting year. Additionally, there was a GBP 4.6 million release from a revision to profit commission payable for 2014 and prior years, and a net GBP 9.814 million release from a revision to unallocated loss adjustment expenses (ULAE) for prior years. The claims development triangle is considered unreliable for direct calculation of prior year development due to the RITC transaction.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2015 and 2016 years of account have seen positive claims experience
the RITC of 2015 has also resulted in a release of reserves
The RITC yielded a profit for the Syndicate of GBP 49m as the premium was below the booked reserves

The calculation of estimated profit commission payable was revised to align with the recognition of premium. This resulted in a release of profit commission payable on the 2014 and prior years of account of GBP 4.6m.

The calculation of estimated unallocated loss adjustment expenses (ULAE) was revised during calendar year 2017 to consider costs at a more granular level by department. This revision resulted in an overall release of GBP 7.8m of ULAE

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle is distorted by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of 2008-2015 years of account, making it unreliable for direct calculation of prior year development. The prior year development figure is taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table. The ULAE release for prior years is a gross figure from the breakdown provided.
